paite: TOUPA phat un! Pathian phat a lasak ahoih a; amah zaw mi deihsak asiam a, phat akilawm him ahi.
heading: Pathian, Bangkim Hihthei Phatna

paite: TOUPA'N Jerusalem adingsak nawn a; Israel delhkhiakte apikhawm nawn hi.
Khasiate ahihdam a, aliamnate uh atuam zel hi.
Aksi tamdan asim a; amin uh asa chiat hi.
TOUPA athupi a, thilhihtheihna ah leng hattak ahi; apilna in tawp ni anei kei ding hi.
TOUPA'N thunuailutte alen gige a; migilou-saloute lei ah ahihniam zel hi.
Kipahthu gen a TOUPA pahtawi in la sa unla; kaihging toh i Pathian phat in la sa un.
Ama'n van meipi akhuhsak a, lei a ding in vuah asutuah a, tangte ah loupa apousak hi.
Ama'n sa kiang ah anek ding apia a, va-aknou hamhamte kiang ah toh.
Amah sakol hatna ah akipak kei a; mihing khe tungte ah leng kipahna himhim anei kei naknak hi.
TOUPA amah laute tung leh azahngaihna lamente tung ah akipak hi.
Jerusalem aw, TOUPA phat un; Zion aw, na Pathian phat in.
Ama'n na kulh kongkhakte kalhna singtawnte akhauhsak a; na sung a na tate om lah avualzawl ngala.
Na gamgi sung ah lemna abawl a; buh hoihpen in ahon hihdim hi.
Athupiak lei ah asawlkhia a, hattak in athu atai hi.
Vuk belam mul bang in apia a; vuk kia vut bang in athehzak hi.
Atui khal tanghou them bang in apaikhia a, amah votna ma ah kua ahia dingh thei ding?
Athu asawlkhia a, huaite azulsak a, huih anungsak a tuite ahong luang hi.
Athu Jakobte kiang ah alangsak a, Israelte kiang ah adan thusehte leh avaihawmte alangsak hi.
Ama'n kua nam tung ah mah huchibang in ahih ngei kei a; avaihawmte athei sam kei uhi. TOUPA phat un!
